signalValue.note: Listed on FutureCast early target board

vaultScouting.evaluation: Winn is a 6-7.5 / 255 tackle. On the Bonner sophomore sit he drives the end 10 yards, washes the down block, and pancakes with a locked grip. Pass set is still raw.
vaultScouting.comparison: Winn comps to Walker Little — 6-7 / 313 long tackle who wins with length and a nasty finish before the lower half fills.
vaultScouting.projection: Winn projects as a Year 1 developmental tackle, then he competes for the job in Year 2, with Year 3 starter upside if the feet catch the frame.
strengths: Winn locks his hands on the edge and drives the end 10 yards down the field before he buries him.
Winn washes the down block and collapses the front so the back has a lane.
Winn finishes with a pancake — he keeps the grip and puts the rusher in the turf.
Winn uses that 6-7.5 wingspan to engulf high-school ends before they get a second move.
vaultScouting.schemeFit: Winn fits a vertical-set tackle who can maul in the run game while the pass set gets cleaner.
